subject: Problems with reading data in secr

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Problems with reading data in secr
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to read the data en secr but I get the following error:

traps.txt

8a.3 -73.7081349777833 -40.5268732908298
7a.3 -73.7081816067595 -40.5269348410783
6a.3 -73.7082301008947 -40.5270019868039
5a.3 -73.7082991117794  -40.5270616718934
4a.3 -73.7083513362326 -40.5271549298457


captures,txt

g1 01_1 1 4z.1
g1 01_1 2 5c.1
g1 02_1 1 3e.1
g1 02_1 5 1d.1
g1 03_1 1 5b.1

> monitoCH <- read.capthist("captures.txt", "traps.txt", detector = "single", noccasions = 14)
Error in read.table(file, row.names = 1, as.is = T, colClasses = colcl,  : 
  duplicate 'row.names' are not allowed

Best,

Manuel

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Problems with reading data in secr
parts:
It would seem that you have an error in your detector file (detector names should be unique). Also, I don't think you will get sensible results with longitude and latitude as coordinates. Project these to some coordinate system in metres (e.g. UTM).
Murray
